new_forms: Donor for-loop traversal and pool-count postincrement owned by the final volume store; absent from all prior archived controls.
version_limits: This public PC/Dolphin family is not authenticated original N64 source.
The donor numRunning field and writes are absent from both native bodies and were not adopted.

Native group and node capacities are 32. Donor group and starting-node capacities are 64; donor RUN_LIST_SIZE is 64 through version 2.0.0 and 128 from version 2.0.1 onward (snd3d.c lines390-399). All native capacities are preserved.
The donor >=2.0.1 low-pass-filter float and field are absent from native; the genuine pointer plus five float arguments are preserved.
Native field geometry remains unchanged: 12-byte groups, 12-byte small nodes, 28-byte large nodes on O32.
